SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
1031
12 8 41

S.I SP. Br. ........................................Station. File No....................... Date August 11, 1941

SUBJECT: Edwin Vincent CUNNINGHAM

Edwin Vincent CUNNINGHAM, age 27, residing
at House 70, Lane 41 Carter Road, is as far as can
be ascertained, un employed at present.

Some three or four years ago he was a teacher
at, it is believed, St. John's University. During
this period Kum Soo (甘月松 ), a wealthy Chinese,
made a complaint to Bubbling Well Station regarding
his son who was stated to have stolen some money
from his father and at the same time Cunningham, who
was apparently the boy's teacher, was accused of
having helped him to spend it. No action was taken
in this matter and Cunningham was later discharged.
12 8 41
He then worked as a barman at Ma Jackson's, 292
Bubbling Well Road.

In April 1939, he made application to the
S.M.C. for a tavern licence at 190 Nanking Road, the
Victoria Cafe, former premises of the Victoria Club.
He was associated with one V. T. Chow in this venture.
However, in January 1940 the licence was transferred
to another Chinese and as far as is known Cunningham
is no longer interested.

In February 1940, Cunningham was involved in a
dispute at the Van Hwa Barbers Shop(范華 ) over
the theft of a Chinese female's coat (F.I.R. L.618/40)
Apparently the female was not satisfied with the
amount of compensation offered to her by the shop
master for the loss of the coat and brought along
her husband and Cunningham to give greater weight
to her demands. However there was no evidence of
extortion or intimidation although Cunningham's actions
were a little doubtful.

A.C.( S.B.)
R.W. Mac Culie
D. S. I.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH AUG 11 1941）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
1031
1941年8月12日

特别处 ........................................分局。档案号....................... 日期 1941年8月11日

事由：埃德温·文森特·坎宁安 (Edwin Vincent CUNNINGHAM)

埃德温·文森特·坎宁安，27岁，现居卡特路 (Carter Road) 41弄70号，据查目前失业。

约三、四年前，他据信在圣约翰大学任教。在此期间，一位名叫甘月松 (Kum Soo) 的中国富商向静安寺捕房投诉其子，称其子从父亲处窃取了一些钱款；同时，身为该男孩教师的坎宁安被指控协助其挥霍赃款。此事未采取任何行动，坎宁安随后被解聘。
1941年8月12日
此后，他在静安寺路292号马杰克逊酒吧 (Ma Jackson's) 担任酒保。

1939年4月，他向工部局申请位于南京路190号维多利亚咖啡馆（前维多利亚俱乐部旧址）的酒馆执照。在此项目中，他与一名叫 V. T. Chow 的人有关联。然而，1940年1月，该执照转让给另一名中国人，据所知，坎宁安已不再参与此事。

1940年2月，坎宁安卷入范華理发店 (Van Hwa Barbers Shop) 的一起纠纷，涉及一件中国女性大衣被盗案（报案记录号 L.618/40）。显然，该女子对店主就大衣丢失所提供的赔偿金额不满，遂带上其丈夫及坎宁安前来，以增强其诉求的分量。然而，尽管坎宁安的行为略显可疑，但并无敲诈或恐吓的证据。

助理督察长（特别处）
R.W. Mac Culie
副督察长

（印：上海公共租界警务处特别处 1941年8月11日）
（批：归档）
（批：12/8）
